ov: أنا أؤدي روكي (الإنجليزية: I Play Rocky) فيلم سيرة ذاتية درامي أمريكي صدر عام 2026، من إخراج بيتر فاريلي وتأليف بيتر غامبل. يتناول الفيلم مراحل تطوير وإنتاج فيلم روكي الصادر عام 1976. ويؤدي أنتوني إيبوليتو دور سيلفستر ستالون، ويشاركه البطولة آناصوفيا روب وتوبي كيبيل وبي جاي بيرن وجاي دوبلاس ومات ديلون وستيفان جيمس وتريسي ليتس. عرض الفيلم للمرة الأولى في مهرجان تورونتو السينمائي الدولي لعام 2026، حيث نافس على جائزة اختيار الجمهور. وبدأ عرضه السينمائي في الولايات المتحدة بشكل واسع بواسطة أمازون إم جي إم ستوديوز في 20 نوفمبر 2026. وتلقى مراجعات إيجابية عموما من النقاد.
plotEn:
In the early 1970s, Mike Stallone struggles to make it as an actor in New York City, living on the edge of homelessness while juggling low-paying jobs and auditions. Sleeping outside one night, Mike finds and adopts a puppy that he names Butkus. He reluctantly stars in a softcore pornography film to help pay his rent.
Mike starts to date his coworker Sasha Czack, and introduces her to his father, Frank. Frank is dismissive of his son's acting aspirations and sees him as unintelligent, much to Sasha's disgust. She encourages Mike to start using his real name, Sylvester, and to try his hand at writing scripts. Sylvester and Sasha marry and relocate to Los Angeles. A friend introduces Sylvester to film producers Robert Chartoff and Irwin Winkler, who have little interest but meet with him as a courtesy to discuss his idea for a union movie. On the way out, Sylvester sneaks one of his scripts, Paradise Alley, into their secretary's pile. Impressed with the quality of his writing but finding that particular script unsuitable for production, Chartoff and Winkler encourage Sylvester to share any future writing.
When Sasha becomes pregnant, the couple find themselves in greater financial difficulties, and Sylvester is forced to sell Butkus. Drinking at a bar, he sees the Muhammad Ali vs. Chuck Wepner championship fight, and is moved by Wepner, the underdog, lasting fifteen rounds, far longer than expected. He goes home and stays up all night writing a new screenplay, Rocky. Chartoff
